We quantify the visual text generation quality from two aspects: (1) CLIP score measures the semantic relevance between the generated image and the input prompt by calculating the cosine similarity of their representations from CLIP image and text model. (2) OCR Accuracy detects the texts in the generated images utilizing OCR tools. We calculate the precision, recall and F1 score between the detected texts and the ground truths.
